# A fresh state is not ready, with named failures and a non-zero exit.
! exec drivebridge doctor --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf
stdout 'state_dir *fail'
stdout 'rclone_config *fail'
stdout 'not ready \(failed: '
! stdout 'token'

# Fully configured local mode is ready.
mkdir local
mkdir bin
exec sh -c 'printf "#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n" > bin/ffprobe && chmod 0755 bin/ffprobe'
env PATH=$WORK/bin:${PATH}
exec sh -c 'umask 177; printf "[one]\ntype = onedrive\n" > rclone.conf'
exec drivebridge space-add --state $WORK/state --space creative --remote one --drive-id drive --root-id root --local-root $WORK/local --max-bytes 1048576
exec drivebridge doctor --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf --json
stdout '"mode":"local"'
stdout '"ready":true'
stdout '"status":"success"'

# Human mode still prints per-check lines.
exec drivebridge doctor --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf
stdout 'state_dir *pass'
stdout 'ready\.$'

# Declaring handoff intent without a running listener blocks readiness.
! exec drivebridge doctor --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf --json --handoff
stdout '"ready":false'
stdout 'handoff_socket_missing'

# An over-exposed state directory is rejected without creating anything.
mkdir exposed
chmod 0755 exposed
! exec drivebridge doctor --state $WORK/exposed --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf
stdout 'state_dir *fail *state_dir_not_private'
